findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed multiple dead adult roaches on the floor in dry storage. PIC stated the Pest Control Log is in the main office. Advise updating log for Pest Control Provider. Ensure physical facilities are cleaned in their entirety to better monitor pest activity.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure
findings.comment:
Facility does not have sufficient hot water available at the 3 compartment sink to meet demand throughout operation. Staff indicated that hot water is available in the morning. However by lunchtime, staff are heating pots of water on the stove to use while washing dishes. Ensure sufficient hot water is available to meet need.
5-103.11: The water source and system shall be of sufficient capacity to meet the peak water demands (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands. [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Food employee observed turning the faucet off with bare hands after washing hands. CORRECTED- Discussed handwashing procedure with employee and PIC. Employees must use a barrier (paper towel, for example) to turn faucet off and prevent soiling newly clean hands.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. [P]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.15(A) Employee portioning canned fruit handled a sanitizer wiping cloth with gloved hands to wipe down the can opener and returned to portioning fruit without a glove change. Proper use of single use gloves was discussed. Employee washed hands and put on a new pair of gloves prior to continuing with the task.
Single use gloves shall be used for only one task, used for no other purpose, and discarded when damaged or soiled, or when interruptions occur in the operation.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-501.112 Evidence of roach activity was observed in glue traps with several oriental cockroaches (also known as water bugs) present. Traps were located in the dry storage room, by the freezer along the south wall, and under the 3 part sink along the north wall. Discussed frequency for changing out glue traps. Ensure traps are checked daily and changed as needed (see general comments for additional information).
Dead or trapped birds, insects, rodents, and other pests shall be removed from control devices and the premises at a frequency that prevents their accumulation, decomposition, or the attraction of pests.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Food employee was observed changing gloves without a handwash in between. Employee was advised on handwashing between tasks and glove changes. Hands were properly washing prior to putting on a new pair of gloves to continue with food prep. 
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands must also be washed prior to putting on gloves and between glove changes.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11 Plastic container used for storage of food thermometers was soiled with a few small pieces of general debris and buildup. Two of the three thermometers were not in cases allowing for the food contact surfaces to be in direct contact with soiled surfaces. Storage container was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. 
Clean utensils and equipment shall be stored in a clean, dry location, where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Employee did not wash hands between ware washing and handling clean pans and parchment paper to begin portioning single service articles for food and was then observed getting ready to put on gloves without first washing hands. Proper handwashing between tasks was discussed.

Food employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles and after engaging in activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.citation_text:
6-501.110 Employee purse was observed on dry storage shelving next to food. Purse was placed in proper storage area behind the storage room door. 

Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employee clothing and other possessions.
